# Repository Description for GitHub SEO

## Primary Description (Use in repository "About" section)
```
Enterprise Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) + Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) platform with causal inference, incrementality testing, and budget optimization. Built for $10M+ marketing spend measurement.
```

## Alternative Descriptions (A/B Test)

### Option A - Technical Focus
```
Hierarchical Bayesian MMM with PyMC, Markov chain attribution, Shapley values, causal DAG discovery, double ML, synthetic control, geo experiments, and CVXPY budget optimization. Production-ready Python framework.
```

### Option B - Business Value Focus
```
Stop wasting 30% of marketing budgets. Unified causal framework for ROI measurement, cross-channel attribution, and data-driven budget allocation. Trusted by enterprise marketing teams.
```

### Option C - Comprehensive
```
Open-source marketing measurement: Bayesian MMM + MTA + causal inference. Features adstock modeling, saturation curves, incrementality testing, and automated budget optimization. Includes Streamlit dashboards and REST API.
```
